# StatusPill

Signals live system state — agent mode, engine health, anomaly alerts.

`SuDuAI.StatusPill` · Status

## Use

```jsx
<SuDuAI.StatusPill>…</SuDuAI.StatusPill>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SuDuAI.StatusPill">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Live-status pill: a 6px glowing indicator dot plus a short label.

## Props (StatusPillProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `status` | `'ok' \| 'warn' \| 'error' \| 'idle'` | ok = neon, warn = teal-dim, error = error, idle = outline. |
| `pulse` | `boolean` | Adds the expanding ping ring used for active/executing states. |
